english.title: Public service vehicle - offensive passenger failing to quit vehicle

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: PUBLIC SERVICE VEHICLES CONDUCT OF DRIVERS

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a passenger on a public service vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), remained on the vehicle when directed to leave by the

(A)_[driver]_
(B)_[inspector]_
(C)_[conductor]_

on the grounds that your condition was such as would be likely to cause offence to a reasonable passenger
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 6(1)(k)(iii) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25 of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 6 re other forms of misconduct by passengers.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Further detail may be included in the Statement of Facts in relation to how the matter came to the attention of the police and any explanation given by the defendant.
